energy_distribution_equivalence_test.principle: Cross-check that the same broken sampler produces statistically-equivalent distributions on both substrates.

kv260_speedup_vs_same_schedule_cpu.principle: The apples-to-apples speedup measurement. < 1.0 means KV260 is slower at this n; >= 1.0 means faster.

methodology_note: CPU baseline: one fixed-budget even/odd synchronous checkerboard Glauber sweep per recorded sample on the Exp 2898 n=64 uploaded sparse q8.8 basis, with dense Exp 2898 energy scoring. Exp 2912 is kept as an audited sequential-Gibbs shape comparison and is not used for the speedup numerator. KV260 timing is the cited Exp 2898 24.0 us/sample hardware-smoke median. The energy equivalence check uses the same synchronous schedule energy traces supplied to the artifact builder.
paper_v6_recommendation: retract: KV260 is slower than the same-schedule CPU baseline at n=64; paper-v6 must retract the current speedup claim.
